name: GlusterFS Open-Source Distributed File Storage
free_limit: GPLv2/LGPLv3+-licensed open-source distributed network filesystem for self-managed scale-out file storage on commodity servers; no vendor-imposed storage capacity, node or transfer quota for the software.
watch_out: Requires your own servers, disks, network, replication, backups, monitoring and security maintenance. Red Hat Gluster Storage commercial product reached EOL in December 2024, distinct from the upstream open-source Gluster project; check upstream release maintenance and GPL/LGPL obligations. No managed storage or SLA is included.
